title: ci_workflow_perf: read the adapter's native-target test where it now lives

results.root_cause: 192b53d27 (T-AGYFURY-1) moved the susi-harness adapter's unit tests, including start_worktree_uses_native_private_target_without_shell_seeding, from adapter.rs to src/tests/adapter.rs for the line ceiling; the guard still searched adapter.rs for seed-target.sh and failed on origin/main
results.fix: the guard checks scripts/workflow-session-start.sh as before and checks that src/tests/adapter.rs pins the native private target by test name; nothing else changes
results.tests: ci_workflow_perf 27/27 (was 26 passed, 1 failed on origin/main); cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -D warnings clean; fmt clean

limitations: the guard is a text check, as before; the behaviour itself is proven by the adapter test it names
